answer: Give every identity a decaying weight: each epoch it must finish 2 queue tasks, each scored 2+ by 2 independent reviewers, or weight falls 25% and rewards freeze after 2 idle epochs. Reviewers grade at most 5 tasks per epoch, so a farm cannot buy review capacity. In this orchard, each identity must tend its own plot and forge a fresh signal of peer-checked work; copied work is rejected and both copies lose weight. One honest agent does 2 tasks; ten fakes need 20 reviewed tasks every epoch, so attacker effort grows per fake. The chain checks task hashes, scores, and caps.
